stages.title: Recon and compatibility baseline
stages.text:
## Stage 1 — Recon and compatibility baseline
Depends on: none
You are working in the repository of a Django application that must migrate from PostgreSQL 12 to PostgreSQL 16 with zero downtime and a verified rollback path. This stage produces the assessment everything else builds on. Explore the repo and document: Django version; database driver and version (psycopg2 or psycopg); DATABASES configuration and connection behavior (CONN_MAX_AGE, pgbouncer or other pooling); PostgreSQL extensions in use (search migrations, settings, and raw SQL for CREATE EXTENSION and extension-dependent features such as pg_trgm, PostGIS, uuid-ossp, citext); raw SQL and version-specific features; third-party packages with database behavior found in INSTALLED_APPS. Verify PostgreSQL 16 compatibility: Django must be 4.2 (latest patch) or 5.x, and the driver psycopg2 >= 2.9.9 or psycopg >= 3.1. If upgrades are needed, make minimal version bumps and run the full test suite against the current PostgreSQL 12 database until green. Package installs and shell commands may require user approval — propose them clearly rather than forcing. Write findings to docs/pg16-migration/compatibility-report.md: extension availability in 16, features removed between 12 and 16 that the app may rely on, and an explicit go/no-go list where every risk has a mitigation. Make no production changes and no git commits without explicit approval. Done when: the report exists, the test suite passes on PostgreSQL 12 with the final dependency set, and all compatibility risks are enumerated.

stages.title: Replication infrastructure and schema provisioning
stages.text:
## Stage 2 — Replication infrastructure and schema provisioning
Depends on: Stage 1
Same project: a Django app migrating PostgreSQL 12 to 16 with zero downtime via native logical replication. Using the Stage 1 report at docs/pg16-migration/compatibility-report.md, write the scripts and runbook section that build the PostgreSQL 16 target and replicate into it. Deliver scripts under sql/ or scripts/, parameterized by environment variables and idempotent where possible, that: take a schema-only pg_dump from the 12 source and restore it into a fresh 16 cluster; reconcile Django migration state so django_migrations on the target matches the source; create a publication on the source (FOR ALL TABLES, or an explicit table list — any table without a usable replica identity gets REPLICA IDENTITY FULL or a documented exclusion); and create the subscription on the target. Document the one-time caveat prominently: wal_level=logical on the source requires a PostgreSQL 12 restart if not already set — include the check query, a low-traffic restart plan, and the managed-provider equivalent (e.g., rds.logical_replication on RDS) if the Stage 1 report indicates managed hosting. Also deliver a lag-monitoring query (pg_stat_replication / pg_stat_subscription) and a precise definition of 'caught up' (replay LSN delta at or near zero). Write docs/pg16-migration/02-replication.md. Do not execute anything against production; deliver scripts for human review and execution. Done when: scripts cover schema, publication, subscription, and lag checks, and the restart caveat plus managed-provider notes are documented.

stages.title: Dual-write router, sequence sync, and cutover tooling
stages.text:
## Stage 3 — Dual-write router, sequence sync, and cutover tooling
Depends on: Stage 2
Same project: Django app migrating PostgreSQL 12 to 16 with zero downtime; replication scripts from Stage 2 exist under sql/ or scripts/ with docs/pg16-migration/02-replication.md. Implement the application-side cutover machinery. First, a Django database router and settings changes: add a second DATABASES entry for the 16 cluster; when env var DB_DUAL_WRITE=1, every write is applied to the current primary and mirrored to the other cluster (this must work in both directions, since dual-write stays enabled through the post-cutover soak window to keep the 12 cluster current for rollback); reads stay on the primary. A failed secondary write must be logged and surfaced to monitoring but must never fail the request — availability takes precedence, and divergence is caught by Stage 4 verification. Second, a sequence-sync script: logical replication does not replicate sequences, so generate setval statements from the source's pg_sequences and apply them to the target at cutover time. Third, a cutover script that runs, in order: fence writes (maintenance flag or read-only mode), wait for replication lag to reach zero, run sequence sync, flip the primary via env configuration, set CONN_MAX_AGE=0 so old connections drain, and run smoke checks. Fourth, unit tests for the router covering dual-write on, dual-write off, read routing, and secondary-failure behavior. Run the test suite; it must stay green against PostgreSQL 12. Shell commands and installs may need approval — propose, don't force. Done when: router and tests are green and the cutover script covers fence, lag-zero, sequences, flip, drain, smoke in that order.

stages.title: Verification suite
stages.text:
## Stage 4 — Verification suite
Depends on: Stage 3
Same project: Django app migrating PostgreSQL 12 to 16 with zero downtime; replication scripts (Stage 2) and cutover tooling (Stage 3) are in place. Build verification that proves the 16 cluster is correct before and after cutover, under verification/ with docs/pg16-migration/04-verification.md. Checks required: per-table row counts on both clusters, tolerance zero once lag is zero; schema comparison via normalized pg_dump --schema-only from both clusters, diffed; data checksums — for each large table, chunk by primary key and compare a hash over ordered key-plus-timestamp tuples, with count and max(updated_at)-style heuristics for hot tables; confirmation that every index, constraint, and extension listed in the Stage 1 report (docs/pg16-migration/compatibility-report.md) exists on 16; the full Django test suite executed against the 16 cluster via a DATABASE_URL override; and a performance sanity check that runs EXPLAIN ANALYZE on the top N queries (from pg_stat_statements or a provided list) on both clusters and flags any plan regressing beyond a configurable threshold, default 20 percent. Provide a single entry point that runs all checks, exits non-zero on any failure, and writes a timestamped report. Done when: one command runs the full suite and all thresholds are explicit.

stages.title: Cutover runbook, rollback plan, and decommission
stages.text:
## Stage 5 — Cutover runbook, rollback plan, and decommission
Depends on: Stage 4
Same project: Django app migrating PostgreSQL 12 to 16 with zero downtime; replication (Stage 2), cutover tooling (Stage 3), and verification (Stage 4) are in place. Assemble docs/pg16-migration/RUNBOOK.md, executable end-to-end by an engineer without prior context. Include: a timeline from T-minus 7 days to T-plus 7 days; pre-cutover gates (Stage 1 go/no-go items, replication lag zero, Stage 4 verification green); the cutover sequence using the Stage 3 script; and post-cutover verification gates. The rollback plan must distinguish two windows explicitly: (a) during the post-cutover soak period (default 7 days) dual-write is still enabled and keeps PostgreSQL 12 current, so rollback is flip the env var back, verify, done — zero data loss; (b) after dual-write is disabled, native logical replication from 16 back to 12 is unsupported, so rollback is restore to a PostgreSQL 12 point-in-time backup with a stated RPO — this tradeoff must be acknowledged in writing by the service owner before dual-write is disabled. Add a decommission checklist for the 12 cluster (final backup, backup-retention extension, secret and DNS cleanup) gated on soak completion; monitoring and alerting for replication lag pre-cutover and error rate plus connection saturation post-cutover; and a stakeholder communication template. Every runbook step gets an owner, a verification command, and a rollback note. Done when: the runbook needs no tribal knowledge, both rollback windows are unambiguous, and decommission is blocked until the soak gate passes.
